newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Khmer Rouge forces seen in brief internal clash.
newsitem.headline: Khmer Rouge forces seen in brief internal clash.

text.p: Fighting broke out among Khmer Rouge forces in their last rebel stronghold of Anlong Veng for about one hour on Friday morning, a government spokesman said.
"This morning from 9 a.m. to 10 a.m., there was fighting between Khmer Rouge rebels...in Anlong Veng," Leng Sochea, director of the press department, told Reuters.

Senior military adviser Tom Sambol confirmed the report and said the fighting was between Khmer Rouge hardliners loyal to notorious rebel leader Pol Pot and a breakaway group of guerrillas who have defected to the goverment.
Both officials said a large group of rebels had fled about five kilometres eastward.
The fleeing fighters were loyal to Pol Pot, according to Tom Sambol, but Leng Sochea said the troops had not been identified.
